examples.title: A Study to Learn About the Study Medicine (Nirmatrelvir Plus Ritonavir) in Pregnant Women With COVID-19
examples.why: The trial prematurely terminated due to the inability to recruit the planned number of subjects. The decision to terminate the trial was not based on any safety concerns.

examples.title: A Study to Measure the Amount of Study Medicine in Blood in Adult Participants With COVID-19 and Severe Kidney Disease
examples.why: Decision to terminate study was due to slow enrolment and FDA input that available data may be enough for dosing recommendations for severe renal disease (subject to review by FDA).

examples.title: Evaluation of Protease Inhibition for COVID-19 in Standard-Risk Patients (EPIC-SR).
examples.why: Enrollment ceased due to a very low rate of hospitalization or death observed in the standard-risk patient population

summary: The FDA issued its strongest boxed warning that Paxlovid (which includes nirmatrelvir) can cause significant, potentially life-threatening interactions when taken alongside certain other medications [3]. Warnings also note risks of severe allergic reactions, such as anaphylaxis or serious skin reactions, when taking this medication [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than human testing, the drug received low scores for both liver and heart risks [M].
